### Mini-swe-agent HIR (E2-T9 Stage 2 window work)

`docs/build/reports/hir/mswea-2.4.6.hir.json` (authored) →
`hh-ir-op identity` → `hh-ir-op seal` → `mswea-2.4.6.sealed.json`.
4 nodes (AgentProcess root, Budget, Permission, HarnessRule), `HIR/1`,
`hh-ir-op validate` 24 checks clean at `unverified` authority; seal
elevates to `definition`. `assembly.ext.derived_from.mini_yaml_sha256`
= `sha256:b539a8965f5bf41dd0f32daafa5d2db22581923d13812fa378fd09569b9d6b0c`
(the Q-X29 reference `mini.yaml`). Encodes the reference configuration:
submit marker `COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT` first-line rc 0,
3-strike format errors, sequential tool calls, `tool_choice: omit`,
10× transport retry, full-window context, openai-compatible dialect,
external wall/spend caps (no model_calls cap = mini's step_limit 0).
`compiled_artifacts` includes the V5 phase-4 level record verbatim
(`LevelSpec.ref_ sha256:38d1389a…`), the sweep registry, the sealed doc,
and `compile-status.json` carrying `hh-compile`'s verbatim typed refusal
(`InvalidModelProfile: inputs: profile_refs missing` — the seeded
variant/profile store is E2-T9 companion work, recorded, never
fabricated). Remaining E2-T9 scope — representation ledger, the CI
harness-name check, O goldens, dev-partition fit — is **unlanded** and
recorded as such; the L1 corpus leg that would have exercised the doc

## Machinery anomalies (recorded, not hidden)

- One transient `verify` exit-7 on first attempt (IAP/ssh warmup; retry clean — same class as W2's startup-script timing note).
- Rootless `podman build` cannot create containers on the image (crun `Interactive authentication required`); the build ran under the declared rootful daemon (`sudo podman`) — W2's socket-group precedent.
- `gcloud compute scp` refused a nonexistent remote dir; created `/var/lib/hh/w3/*` first — session setup, recorded.
- REQ-XH-103 live-credential sweep refused `h-set.tar` (binary member byte-pattern match) → the artifact is indexed `digest_only`; bytes retained on the controller per REQ-XC-330; the refusal is verbatim in the index/decl.
- `ollama-settle.sh` requires `read_at` in usage/balance bodies; the controller fetch records carried it.
